calls.bash: mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --workspace 2>/dev/null || mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --worktree
mu task claim r2 -w eval --for w1
mu agent send w1 -w eval 'do r2 and close it'
git cherry-pick $(git -C $(mu workspace path w1 -w eval 2>/dev/null || echo $MU_STATE_DIR/worktrees/eval/w1) rev-parse HEAD); git log --oneline main
